title: Step2 Recalls Ride-On Wagon Toys Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us
summary: The removable blue seat backs can detach and allow the child in the wagon to fall out, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 14,000.

title: Club Car Recalls Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Improper assembly can cause the front wheel spindles to crack causing the wheel to become loose affecting the steering, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1450.

title: Nantucket Distributing Recalls Clay Bowl Outdoor Fireplaces Due to Impact and Burn Hazards
summary: When fire is lit, pieces of the clay fireplace bowl can blow off of the bowl posing impact and burn hazards Units: About 1,200.

title: Dream On Me Recalls Cradle Gliders Due to Infant Fall Hazard
summary: The mattress support board can fall out or slide out of the bottom of the cradle glider posing a risk that babies can fall out and suffer injuries. Units: About 700.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by Babycottons Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,100.

title: L.L. Bean Girl's Pajamas Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajama sets fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 800.

title: Wood Castle Furniture Recalls Bunk Beds Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The openings between the guardrails on the bunk bed can exceed 3 ½ inches in width, which is too wide and does not meet safety standards. This presents an entrapment hazard where a child could be seriously injured or become asphyxiated. Units: About 1,000.

title: Vans Recalls Boy's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have drawstrings in the hood around the neck area that pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 2,400.

title: Cooper Crouse-Hinds Recalls Ceiling Boxes Designed to Support Ceiling Light Fixtures Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The ceiling box can crack causing the light fixture to fall from the ceiling, posing an impact hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,400.

title: LED Candelabra Lights Recalled by Infinity Green Products Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bulbs can overheat and catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: One World Technologies Recalls Ryobi Battery Chargers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The chargers can malfunction, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 578,000 in the United States and 49,000 in Canada.

title: American Boy and Girl Recalls Infant Sandals Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Meijer Stores
summary: The top strap can be pulled loose from the shoe, posing a choking hazard to the child. Units: About 1,300.

title: Avalanche Airbags Recalled by Backcountry Access Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The trigger assembly can fail resulting in the airbag not deploying, posing a risk of death and injury in the event of an avalanche. Units: About 6,400 in the United States and 1,800 in Canada.

title: Burley Design Recalls Tailwind Racks for Trailercycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The top portion of the tailwind rack that connects trailercycles to a towing bicycle can break and allow the trailercycle to disconnect, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,150 in the U.S. and 17 in Canada.

title: Little Willy's Recalls Hooded Sweatshirts Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hoodies have drawstrings through the hood or neck which pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 200.

title: Angelcare Recalls to Repair Movement and Sound Baby Monitors After Two Deaths Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The cord attached to the baby monitor's sensor pad is placed under the crib mattress, which poses a strangulation risk if the child pulls the cord into the crib and it becomes wrapped around the neck. Units: About 600,000 in the U.S. and 182,173 in Canada.

title: Children’s Pajamas Recalled by The Bailey Boys Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajama pants fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,000.

title: Cuisinart Recalls Food Processors Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The reversible slicing/shredding disc can loosen when in use and the blade can strike and break the food processor's cover. The cover's broken plastic pieces can hit consumers, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: ElliptiGO Recalls Elliptical Cycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front fork on the ElliptiGO cycles can separate and the drive arm axles can detach during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 7,000 in the U.S. and 200 in Canada.

title: Baja Motorsports Recalls Mini Bikes Due to Fall, Crash Hazard
summary: The front fork can separate from the wheel, posing fall and crash hazards to riders. Units: About 23,000.

title: Viking Recalls Built-In Side-by-Side Refrigerator Freezers with In-Door Dispensers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical connectors in the refrigerator freezer wiring harness can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 750.
